anc1plus.label: ANC1+
anc1plus.question: any antenatal contact at all
anc1plus.meaning: Whether the woman reached antenatal care even once. Failure here is a question of access and contact with the health system.

anc4plus.label: ANC4+
anc4plus.question: the previous WHO minimum
anc4plus.meaning: The focused-ANC standard WHO recommended until 2016. A middle rung: requires sustained contact but not the full schedule.

anc8plus.label: ANC8+
anc8plus.question: the 2016 WHO recommended schedule
anc8plus.meaning: The current WHO standard of eight or more contacts. Failure here is a question of sustained engagement over a whole pregnancy.
